user.title: Select LocalDeck device
user.description: Choose the ESPHome device to configure. Only devices that expose LocalDeck LED lights are accepted.

error.unknown_device: The selected device could not be found.
error.no_lights_found: No LocalDeck LED lights were found on the selected device. Make sure the ESPHome device is set up and online.

abort.no_devices_found: No ESPHome devices found. Make sure the ESPHome integration is set up and at least one device is online.
abort.no_localdeckplus_devices: No LocalDeck devices found. Make sure a LocalDeck is set up in ESPHome and online.
abort.all_devices_configured: All LocalDecks are already added. Remove an existing entry to add one again.

menu.title: LocalDeck options
menu.description: Select a button to configure its press actions and the conditions of its paired LED.

button_menu.title: Button configuration
button_menu.description: {button_name}: Configure the press actions for this button, or manage the conditions of its paired LED.

button_action_single.title: Press action
button_action_single.description: {button_name}: Choose the action to run on a single press. Leave empty to clear the action.

button_action_double.title: Double press action
button_action_double.description: {button_name}: Choose the action to run on a double press. Leave empty to clear the action.

button_action_triple.title: Triple press action
button_action_triple.description: {button_name}: Choose the action to run on a triple press. Leave empty to clear the action.

button_action_long.title: Long press action
button_action_long.description: {button_name}: Choose the action to run on a long press. Leave empty to clear the action.

move_configuration.title: Move configuration to another button
move_configuration.description: {button_name}: Select the button to move this button's configuration to. This will overwrite any existing configuration on the target button, and the source button's configuration will be cleared.

led_conditions_menu.title: LED conditions
led_conditions_menu.description: {button_name}: Manage the rules for this LED. Rules are evaluated in priority order and the first active rule wins: a condition rule is active when its condition matches, and a follow light rule is always active and mirrors the selected light's state, color, and brightness. If no rule is active, the LED is turned off.

add_condition.title: Add condition rule
add_condition.description: {button_name}: Define a condition and the light state (color, brightness, effect) to apply when it matches.

add_follow_light.title: Add follow light rule
add_follow_light.description: {button_name}: Select the light entity to mirror. While this rule is the first active rule, the LED follows that light's state, color, and brightness.

led_condition_menu.title: Condition rule
led_condition_menu.description: {button_name}: Configure, reorder, enable or disable, or delete this rule.

led_condition_edit.title: Edit condition rule
led_condition_edit.description: {button_name}: Update the condition and the light state (color, brightness, effect) to apply when it matches.

led_follow_light_edit.title: Edit follow light rule
led_follow_light_edit.description: {button_name}: Select the light entity to mirror. While this rule is the first active rule, the LED follows that light's state, color, and brightness.

advanced.title: Advanced configuration options
advanced.description: Import or export the button actions and LED bindings, or clear the configuration.

import_export.title: Import / Export configuration
import_export.description: Copy the configuration to export it, or paste a configuration and submit to import it. Only the button actions and LED bindings are included, not the device identity, so it can be copied between LocalDecks.

error.invalid_json: The configuration is not valid JSON.
error.invalid_config: The configuration is not a valid LocalDeck configuration.
